3. Programme

Three Days. One Journey.

Faith Nexus 2027 moves through three interconnected themes designed to take delegates from foundation, through understanding, into action.

14–16 April 2027 · Royal Majestic Hotel, Johannesburg
Day 01 — 14 April 2027

Day 01 — Roots

Faith. Identity. Covenant. Foundations.

Day One creates space to recover the foundations that give Christian influence depth and clarity.

Conversations will explore spiritual formation, Christian identity, Scripture, covenant, historical context and the relationship between faith and society.

Day One will also feature significant Covenant Conversations programming focused on Jewish–Christian learning and bridge-building.

Day 02 — 15 April 2027

Day 02 — Revelation

Media. Technology. AI. Communication. Influence.

Day Two examines the rapidly changing environments shaping how people communicate, create, lead and form communities.

Sessions will explore artificial intelligence, media, technology, digital platforms, the creator economy, communication and influence.

The focus is not simply on understanding new tools, but on asking how Kingdom voices can engage these environments responsibly and creatively.

Day 03 — 16 April 2027

Day 03 — Renaissance

Enterprise. Innovation. Leadership. Culture.

Day Three turns conversation toward construction. What should Christian leaders, institutions, creators and entrepreneurs build for the future?

The day will explore enterprise, innovation, leadership, collaboration, creative culture and institution-building.

Faith Nexus 2027 will conclude with FN100 recognition and a commissioning moment focused on what comes next.
